### Summary of Investigation
- **Failing Test**: [`testLang720`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_d_arch/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringEscapeUtilsTest.java#L428-L432) fails with `ComparisonFailure: expected:<𠮷[A]> but was:<𠮷[?]>` when calling [`StringEscapeUtils.escapeXml`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_d_arch/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringEscapeUtils.java#L505-L507).
- **Intended Behavior**: When escaping strings containing characters from supplementary planes (surrogate pairs) followed by other characters, neither the supplementary characters nor the subsequent characters should be corrupted or truncated.

The living requirement has been saved to [`requirement.feature`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_d_arch/requirement.feature).
